goal: Allow querying historical transactions by address or script without importing keys into the wallet
Lets node operators and applications like Electrum servers query history without third-party indexers
agreement: Broad concept support across multiple reviewers (sedited, l0rinc, w0xlt, kravens, romanz, ViniciusCestarii)
Verified with unit, functional, and regtest testing across various query types (kravens)
Unaddressed objection: TxToJSON declaration violates library boundaries across node and common (kravens)
Nonblocking objection: query read budget ignores block and undo reads allowing excessive disk I/O (kravens)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it satisfies a long-requested feature to index transaction history without wallet keys
Benchmarks show modest resource use of about 52 GB disk space while supporting pruned nodes

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it adds an RPC method exposing transaction history directly to external applications
Resolves an interface gap that previously forced external consumers to run separate indexing tools
